title: THE FOREST DROPPED ITS GREEN
author: Anjali Sahoo
text:
The forest dropped its green,
The sky threw its blue,
And the ocean tossed its noise

For a while
To watch
How she left her known
Niche,
Note
And
Nomenclature
To move towards

The unknown anonymity of the infinite!
stanzas: And the ocean tossed its noise
The unknown anonymity of the infinite!
